narrative.details:
The Stresses of Iron?  Yes, I know the book.  Quite a good one, written by the Dwarven miner Margulf Blaggon a few decades ago.  He spent most his time deep in the mountains of Khaz Modan, digging ore.  Smart fellow!

But where was I?  Oh yes, the Stresses of Iron!  I'm afraid the book was moved to the Northshire Abbey.  The caretaker of the Abbey's library, Brother Paxton, wanted to make a copy of the book for his own shelves.

But that was months ago.  I wonder why it's taking him so long...
narrative.objectives: Speak with Brother Paxton in the Northshire Abbey.
narrative.offerRewardText: Mr. Sheaf is wondering where his book is? Well this is a tad embarrassing. I have the book, but I'm still making my copy and I'm not quite ready to give the original up!

quests.name: Speaking of Fortitude
quests.objectiveText: Go to the Royal Library in Stormwind Keep and speak with Milton Sheaf.

quests.name: Brother Paxton
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Brother Paxton in the Northshire Abbey.

quests.name: Ink Supplies
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Foreman Oslow in Lakeshire and ask him for Rethban Iron Ore.

quests.name: Rethban Ore
quests.objectiveText: Gather 5 loads of Rethban Ore and bring it to Brother Paxton in the Northshire Library.

quests.name: Return to Kristoff
quests.objectiveText: Return to Brother Kristoff in the Cathedral Square.
